title: Trawling for Trolling: A Dataset
measurement_description: The paper created and evaluated a dataset for offensive content detection, where one of the sub-categories for analysis was the presence of hate speech or derogatory terms directed at religious groups. This was measured by classifying text samples into five categories (Normal, Profanity, Trolling, Derogatory, Hate Speech) and analyzing the distribution of abuse types, including religion, within these categories using vocabulary from Hatebase.org.
findings: Based on the analysis of abuse types within the created dataset (Table 3), religion-based hate speech was present but was significantly less prevalent compared to abuse targeting gender, sexual orientation, and ethnicity. In the 'Hate Speech' class, religion-related terms constituted only 1.09% of the identified abuse types.
